mission: Help a parent or student choose a suitable Shinkyokushinkai hall and contact the correct instructor with trustworthy information and minimal friction.
north_star: A visitor can go from landing on the site to a correct direct instructor contact for a suitable hall without needing another intermediary.
stakeholder_outcomes: Visitors quickly understand the offer and age threshold.
Visitors can find halls by city, day, address, school or instructor.
Visitors can share a filtered hall/instructor URL and recover the same state later.
The site feels like a real federation through source-grounded camp, training and trainer media rather than synthetic advertising filler.
Federation information and trainer identity remain source-bound and conservative.
A maintainer can edit canonical content through /admin/ without duplicating recruitment facts across JavaScript files.
The maintainer can distinguish source health, release health, production health and visual acceptance from machine-readable evidence.
target_capabilities: real Kerzhenets / Krasny Plyos federation-adjacent media and photo reports
GitHub-backed content/site.json CMS with fail-closed validation
machine-readable project state and problem registry

strengths.claim: Recruitment/content data has one canonical CMS authority.
strengths.evidence: content/site.json contains hero, camp media, photo reports, all 11 instructors and 18 venue records; build/runtime/admin paths consume the same content model.

strengths.claim: Named trainer media fails closed instead of guessing identity.
strengths.evidence: admin/media-policy.js and scripts/verify-media-policy.mjs require supported source-page/asset pairs and verified identity evidence for new social portraits; wrong CDN pairing, weak evidence and secondary-mirror misuse are negative-tested.

strengths.claim: The runtime ships as a direct self-contained artifact while retaining editable content surfaces.
strengths.evidence: scripts/build-static.mjs emits self-contained production HTML plus health/discovery/admin/content assets; release-contract and prebuilt-output verification enforce the artifact shape.

strengths.claim: The public production release is attributable to an exact Git commit.
strengths.evidence: GitHub Actions run 32796544756 deployed 967a8157f32834ce5ba748d4ad22b9627299a6ca to Vercel deployment dpl_72rU2CYTGV1GnDxD1n61nZbqS5Ee and exact public smoke passed.

strengths.claim: Critical recruitment information is usable before client JavaScript.
strengths.evidence: The built and live contract requires 11 instructors and 18 venues in prerendered HTML, with discovery metadata derived from the same canonical data.

tradeoffs.choice: Keep a static application with a GitHub-backed CMS instead of introducing an application database/backend.
tradeoffs.benefit: Small runtime attack surface, deterministic releases, cheap hosting and one repository-owned source of truth.
tradeoffs.cost: Editing depends on GitHub repository access and the application does not provide a server-owned transactional workflow.

tradeoffs.choice: Use conservative typography fallbacks when a trainer portrait is not source-bound.
tradeoffs.benefit: Avoids publishing the wrong person's image and keeps identity claims auditable.
tradeoffs.cost: Most trainer cards remain less visually rich until exact public portrait provenance is resolved.

tradeoffs.choice: Use selected third-party real media with explicit provenance instead of synthetic promotional imagery.
tradeoffs.benefit: The page remains truthful to real training/camp context.
tradeoffs.cost: External hosts can fail or change, so first-screen and media behavior needs deterministic fallback guards.

accepted_debt.debt: Current source/build/live contracts are deterministic, but representative current desktop/mobile perceptual evidence and owner visual acceptance are still pending.
accepted_debt.why_accepted_now: Functional and production correctness can be proven independently, while visual acceptance requires an actual rendered artifact review rather than inference from CI.
accepted_debt.exit_condition: Review the exact current desktop/mobile render, fix visible defects and record an owner-review candidate/decision.

accepted_debt.debt: Production currently has one source-bound named trainer portrait; active draft PR #51 has two of the required eleven.
accepted_debt.why_accepted_now: Publishing an identity-safe typography card is safer than filling visual space with an ambiguous person or generic event photo.
accepted_debt.exit_condition: Resolve and verify exact source-page-to-asset portrait chains for all 11 instructors and pass verify:portrait-completion.

next_demonstrable_increment.outcome: Complete all 11 trainer portraits with auditable source-bound identity evidence without reducing the current media trust boundary.
acceptance: 11/11 instructors have photo.src and photo.sourceUrl from an allowed provenance chain
new social portraits carry identityStatus=verified and non-trivial identityEvidence
no identity is inferred from face resemblance, a common name, generic event imagery or a search thumbnail
draft incremental CI remains green while work is incomplete
ready-for-review and release paths fail unless verify:portrait-completion is 11/11
exact production release and public smoke pass after merge
evidence_required: source pages that explicitly bind each identity
green media-policy negative and positive tests
